svg.aria-label: Two hand-drawn blobs facing each other: Model and parameters on the left, Behavior (prediction) on the right. A black arrow curves along the bottom from the model to the behaviour, so the model predicts what is seen. A second arrow curves back along the top from the behaviour to the model, labelled Learning, Training, Inference, and a short arrow into the right-hand blob is labelled OBSERVE. That return path and its labels arrive as a build step.
